motions.name: 挥手致意
motions.description: 抬起右手 → 挥手三次 → 放下
motions.prompt: raises the right hand, waves hello three times with an open palm, then lowers the arm

motions.name: 胜利庆祝
motions.description: 蓄势 → 双臂举高 → 握拳庆祝 → 还原
motions.prompt: celebrates winning a billiards match, raises both fists above the shoulders, makes two strong fist pumps, then relaxes

motions.name: 俯身出杆
motions.description: 俯身瞄准 → 两次试杆 → 出杆 → 起身
motions.prompt: mimes a billiards shot without a cue or table, bends forward, extends the left bridge hand, makes two slow practice strokes with the right forearm, one final stroke, then stands upright
